description: Domain-driven compiler: one domain.yaml compiles into backend APIs, typed TypeScript clients, React glue, admin panels and Appwrite schemas through pluggable bridges.
rules: Canonical documentation: https://fellmonkey.github.io/domaincraft-site/docs/ — use it for the current domain.yaml contract and CLI.
Run `domaincraft validate` on domain.yaml before `domaincraft generate`; validation must pass first.
Do not edit generated files. Put business logic in scaffold-once (overwrite: false) custom files.
Bridges compose in layers with `extends` and `--replace layer=bridgeRef`; official bridges are embedded in the binary.
Table, column, enum wire and index names come from the core IR; never re-derive them in templates with snakecase.
Screens are built against the generated typed client. admin-alpine is the only generated UI.
